value.title: Sfere Ulula-Luna
value.synopsis: Di colpo alcune sfere misteriose iniziano a controllare la mente degli abitanti della città.

value.title: Mini-Ninja calciatori
value.synopsis: Owlette learns that being part of the team means coaching Catboy and Gekko to defeat Night Ninja.

value.title: Lionel Sauro
value.synopsis: Romeo uses some special treats to turn Greg's pet gecko Lionel into a giant that he can control. The PJ Masks now have to try to find a way to turn Lionel back to normal, while also keeping the now dinosaur-sized gecko from wrecking the city.

value.title: Il pupazzo di Gattoboy
value.synopsis: The PJ Masks have to stop Romeo from replacing all of the town's cuddlies with cuddlies modeled after himself. Meanwhile, Catboy tries to hide the fact that he still has a cuddly of his own, fearing people will find it childish and make fun of him.

value.title: La notte del gatto
value.synopsis: Catboy convinces Owlette and Gekko to help him complete an ancient ritual that could help him become a better hero. Unfortunately, the whole thing turns out to be a trap set up by Luna Girl.

value.title: Gattoboy ci riprova
value.synopsis: Romeo reveals his latest invention, the Rewind-O-Ray, which can put everything and everyone into reverse. When the PJ Masks try to stop him, he simply rewinds them back to HQ every time they show up. Worse still, he intends to eventually rewind the PJ Masks to a time before they became heroes.

value.title: Il raggio lattanti
value.synopsis: Gekko has to babysit Catboy and Owlette after Romeo zaps them with his new invention and uses it to make everyone act like babies.

value.title: I problemi lunari di Gufetta
value.synopsis: When Romeo steals Luna Girl's Luna Board and magnet, she asks the heroes for help in getting them back. But will she and Owlette be willing to set aside their rivalry?

value.title: Ninja Falene
value.synopsis: The Moths and the Ninjalinos have gone rogue by teaming up to get rid of their own leaders.

value.title: Chi ha il potere del gufo?
value.synopsis: Night Ninja tricks the heroes with a fake treasure hunt.

value.title: Superpigiaflipper
value.synopsis: Just as the PJ Masks think they can handle everything, Romeo steals a wrecking ball and uses it to turn the whole city into the world's largest pinball machine.

value.title: Il rimbalzatore
value.synopsis: Night Ninja steals Romeo’s latest invention, the Bounce-a-lot Machine, to make his Sticky Splats bouncy, which he and the Ninjalinos spread all around the city, creating chaos.

value.title: Carri bizzarri
value.synopsis: Night Ninja and Romeo team up to steal all the floats from the upcoming carnival parade; Gekko tries to save his favorite float.

value.title: Il travestimento di Romeo
value.synopsis: Romeo captures Owlette and uses a new invention to impersonate her so he can trick Catboy and Gekko into capturing Luna Girl, her Moths, Night Ninja and his Ninjalinos.

value.title: PJ Robot
value.synopsis: Romeo creates a little robot that he controls with a remote control.

value.title: Nuovi super poteri
value.synopsis: PJ Robot has been hard at work, trying his best to be helpful from creating a means of communication to cleaning up the Cat-Car to trying to make a few modifications to the PJ Picture Player. But none of them are needed by The PJ Masks.

value.title: La gara sulla Luna
value.synopsis: During the day The PJ masks and their class go to the museum and learn about the harvest moon and figure that since Luna girl likes the moon she is going to plan something bad.

value.title: Stregati dalla Luna: la fortezza lunare
value.synopsis: Luna Girl captured Catboy and Owlette while they were talking to Gekko who stayed behind in the HQ rocket with PJ robot.

value.title: Il gattino di robot
value.synopsis: While trying to stop Romeo from turning people into pets, Catboy gets turned into a cat.

value.title: Geco, signore degli abissi
value.synopsis: Gekko is afraid to ask for help when he must fight Romeo's Roboctopus underwater.

value.title: Che vinca il potere piu forte
value.synopsis: Romeo creates an all-in-one belt to combat the PJ Masks' new powers.

value.title: La luna rotta
value.synopsis: When Romeo starts digging on the moon, the PJ Masks enlist Luna Girl's help.

value.title: La salita alla montagna misteriosa
value.synopsis: The PJ Masks have to stop Night Ninja from stealing a magical ring hidden at the top of Mystery Mountain.

value.title: Il prigioniero della montagna
value.synopsis: The PJ Masks have to stop Night Ninja from stealing a magical ring hidden at the top of Mystery Mountain.

value.title: I bimbi lupo
value.synopsis: The PJ Masks face the newest villains in town: the Wolfies.
